kpis.name: Rule-evaluation correctness
kpis.details: Verified across SequentialAnd, WeightedPriority, and DecisionTree strategies.

kpis.name: Slot allocation safety
kpis.measured: 0 duplicates across 1,000 allocation attempts (10 slots x 100 attempts)
kpis.details: Verified strict mutual exclusion on exclusive slot leases.

kpis.name: Deadlock handling
kpis.measured: 100% detected in 0.02 ms (cycle: T2 -> T3 -> T1)
kpis.details: Cycle detection via Depth First Search on Wait-For-Graph.

kpis.name: Ranking correctness & optimality
kpis.target: 100% reference cohorts return expected order; 0 score deviation
kpis.details: Deterministic tie-break with CGPA and Student ID fallback.

kpis.name: Computation latency
kpis.target: p95 <= 100 ms for reference skill graph
kpis.details: Repeated ranking benchmark across candidate cohort.

kpis.name: Lookup efficiency
kpis.target: p95 shortlist-index lookup <= 1 ms; dual Hash & AVL support
kpis.details: Both Hash and AVL tree indices operational with identical retrieval semantics.

kpis.name: Cache effectiveness
kpis.details: Version-guarded shortlist cache prevents stale graph_version reads.

kpis.name: Graph dual representation comparison
kpis.measured: AdjacencyList: baseline graph; AdjacencyMatrix: verified (ADJACENCY_MATRIX, version: matrix-v2)
kpis.details: Matrix representation models student-drive bipartite relationship alongside AdjacencyList.

kpis.name: Transaction integrity (ACID)
kpis.target: 100% ACID test cases pass at documented isolation level
kpis.details: Strict 2-Phase Locking with WAL journal and undo recovery.

kpis.name: Application safety & idempotency
kpis.target: 0 duplicate applications in concurrent creation attempts
kpis.measured: Exactly 1 record created out of 100 attempts (duplicates: 0)
kpis.details: Hash index uniqueness constraint ensures single insertion per key.

kpis.name: Query performance
kpis.target: p95 <= 200 ms for agreed drive and application queries
kpis.details: Hand-built B+Tree and Hash indices accelerate range and point lookups.

kpis.name: Audit coverage
kpis.target: 100% transitions have actor, time, before/after, and correlation_id
kpis.details: Append-only audit log in custom storage tracks all mutation lifecycle events.

kpis.name: Crash Recovery RTO / RPO
kpis.measured: RPO = 0s (no data loss); RTO = < 1s (instantaneous WAL replay)
kpis.details: WAL Redo-phase committed transactions; Undo-phase rolled back in-flight transactions.

kpis.name: Workflow correctness
kpis.details: State machine enforced exclusively by Team C per docs/01 §1.4.

kpis.name: Traceability & Correlation ID
kpis.target: 100% calls searchable by correlation_id across all hops
kpis.measured: 100% verified across Team D -> Team C -> Team A -> Team B
kpis.details: X-Correlation-ID preserved through headers, envelopes, and audit log entries.

kpis.name: Security & Role Authorization
kpis.target: 0 unauthorized actions; sensitive APIs require auth
kpis.measured: 0 unauthorized role actions permitted; 401 & 403 enforced on protected routes
kpis.details: Signed JWT auth with role claims (Student, Faculty_TPO, Placement_Admin).

kpis.name: Accessibility & Keyboard Navigation
kpis.measured: 100% critical flows operable via Tab/Enter; mobile & desktop verified in Playwright
kpis.details: 5/5 Playwright E2E browser tests passed covering student login, drives, search, modal, admin controls.

kpis.name: Error handling & resilience
kpis.target: 100% backend error classes map to clear user feedback
kpis.details: Standard error envelope parsed into user-friendly alerts.
